notes.title: Small Bug Fix Update
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug that was causing text to run together at the end of trainer battles and occasionally causing freezes. This was a stubborn one. Sorry it took so long to track this one down guys.

notes.title: Minor bug fix update
notes.notes: Added a fix for a softlock that can occur when you save in front of the first boss and get defeated and reload the save

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug where the Hexed variant of Kem was not working properly.

2. Changed damage calculations slightly to make stall tactics a little less powerful.

3. Added some fail safes to avoid rare freezing bug in battle dialogue.

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.notes:
1. Fixed walls in Coffee shop in the second town which allowed players to get out of bounds.

2. Potential fix for a freeze related to a couple of moves missing an effect. Still looking further into this issue.

notes.title: Patch notes #2
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug where ultra widescreen and a couple of other resolutions could not view menu options

notes.title: Biggest Xenos Demo Update to Date!
notes.notes:
Added:

[list]
[*] Day and Night Cycle - A day and night cycle based on your devices time. Sun will rise and set and at night street lights will kick on to light the way. Battle background also changes after dark.
[*] Character Creation - Choose your name and select from 7 avatars to represent you.
[*] Nick Naming - You can now give a nick name to any Xeno you capture. Some creature catchers may nick name their Xenos as well.
[*] 20 new moves added
[*] A whole host of bug and balance fixes
[*] 1 new Xeno added
[*] Palette swaps added to variant Xenos.
[/list]

Now is a better time than ever to hop into the demo! Give it a shot!

notes.title: Bug Fix Log 1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Xeno storage would lock up if you changed your selection then exited the screen immediately after - Fixed
[*] After trap disappeared from screen you could still see a small version of the captured Xeno. - Fixed
[*] Move effect placement was very high for some Xenos. - Fixed
[*] Audio effects on several moves were too loud - Fixed several, still looking at all moves.
[*] You could leave the demo area after winning battle against Marco - Fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Huge Demo Update Live Now!
notes.notes:
I have just dropped the a complete overhaul of the original demo. There are more moves, graphical and audio settings, many quality of life updates, updated Xenos models, and so much more! If you haven't already, please give the demo a shot and let me know what you think. If you have already, please revisit. Its like a brand new game!

Known issues:

[list]
[*] Too many graphical settings options in graphics settings menu
[*] Some moves are missing a sound effect or have unbalanced sound volume.
[*] Status effect placement is off on some Xenos.
[*] Using all of your items can slow down bag scrolling.
[/list]

I plan on putting out a couple more small updates to this demo in the coming weeks, then on to full release!

notes.title: Alpha tester branch update, demo will be uneffected
notes.notes: In order to show off some new features during the nextfest stream, I will be updating the build for the early alpha I sent out to a few streamers and friends. This will likely not effect anyone reading this as the demo version is not effected. If you are playing the alpha version provided by a steam key, do not update your game if you wish to finish your playthrough. This update will break saves due to a big change in the way statuses are handled.

notes.title: Community Feedback Alpha Demo Patch
notes.notes:
- Added an identifier that says "your Xeno" whenever your Xeno performs an action in order to avoid confusion when your opponent has the same Xeno (Recommended by Matt from the Awesome Duo and AnarkyKillSwitch)

- Added animation to bag arrows to make horizontal scrolling more obvious (based on Anarky's twitch stream)

- Base battle speed is 25% faster (Recomended by JenjibobCries)

- Added animations based on attack strength (more to come but implemented a few for the demo)

- Fixed message not showing when using a healing item, making it seem like the game soft locked (found on anarky's stream)

- Added the ability to pet the cat in the house in the first town (recommended by Anarky and his viewers)

notes.title: Progress Update, Become an Alpha Tester and Potential Early Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hey guys! I know the store page has been a bit stagnant so I just wanted to give a quick update. First of all, the game is coming along better than I could have hoped. Most of the big features I wanted to be in by demo time have been implemented. Features that I thought would be massive headaches (namely status screens and reworked stat system) have been fairly painless.

The second thing I wanted to address was the lack of trailer. I had one up briefly but I outsourced the making of the trailer and I ultimately just wasn't happy with it. I hope to have an updated trailer and gameplay video up within the next couple of weeks.

Third and most importantly, since development has been going so exceptionally well, I should have a working demo earlier than expected. If all goes according to plan this should be ready by the middle of December. If you are interested in being an alpha tester please drop me an email at edmechgames@yahoo.com . I am looking into dropping the demo early publicly but if you are interested in getting your hands on the demo asap and are okay with some potential rough edges definitely reach out. 

If you want to keep up to date on what I am working on be sure to follow me on twitter as that is where I post the most updates. I try to post at least once a day https://twitter.com/EdMechGames
